en: Colorized vintage view of a small rural railway station. A steam locomotive with a short train stands on the tracks, releasing a bit of steam. To the right is a modest station building with a steep red-tiled roof and half‑timbered gable. A small green kiosk or shelter stands on the platform, and a semaphore signal rises beside the tracks. The landscape around is flat and open countryside. The scene has the soft tones typical of early 20th‑century printed postcards. A station sign on the building reads a short name beginning with the letter "L", likely the station name.
